commit_sequence: flush+fsync open segment through writable descriptor
compute byte length + whole-file SHA-256 + derived raw metadata stats
recovery_principles: No orphan or mismatched bytes are silently deleted.
Incomplete open tail may reuse TASK-005 safe truncation.
Manifest validity requires file hash/size/frame count and derived metadata parity.
known_limitations: Power-loss durability is modeled through ordered fsync/rename operations and injected process-failure phases; CI cannot emulate sudden physical power loss.
No network ingest, normalization, Parquet, retention, or object-storage backup exists yet.
